Reach out to start practical, values-aligned therapy

I'm {{THERAPIST_NAME}}, a {{LICENSE}} therapist offering confidential, evidence-informed support for adults navigating anxiety, relationship strain, transitions, and burnout in {{CITY}}, {{STATE}} and via telehealth.

{{PRIMARY_CTA_LABEL}} View availability
Phone: {{PHONE}} • Email: {{EMAIL}}
Intake snapshot
Most new clients begin with a 50–60 minute intake to assess goals, history, and to co-create an approach that fits your life and priorities.
Intentionality
Therapy anchored in your goals, with measurable steps and regular review.
Collaboration
I partner with you — not direct you — to build practical skills and insight.
Clarity
Transparent fees, scope, and boundaries so you can decide with confidence.

How I work — methods you can expect

  • Integrative, evidence-informed practice: I blend CBT, trauma-informed care, and somatic awareness tailored to your needs.
  • Practical tools: Homework is collaborative and focused on real-life application.
  • Relational focus: We explore patterns in relationships and decision-making that shape your well-being.
  • Modality options: {{MODALITIES}} — offered in person ({{CITY}}) and securely by telehealth.

Common concerns I hear — addressed

“I’m worried therapy will take too long.” I prioritize focused work and will help you set short-term goals alongside deeper exploration.

“Will my information be kept private?” Yes. Sessions are confidential except where disclosure is legally required (safety concerns, court orders). See the privacy note below for details.

“What if I can’t afford ongoing therapy?” I discuss options transparently during our first contact and can suggest limited check-ins, brief therapy structures, or referrals when appropriate.

What people have said

“Practical, compassionate, and honest — I left sessions with tools I could use that week.”
— A.S.
“I appreciated the clear structure and real-world focus. It felt like coaching and therapy in a balanced way.”
— R.M.
Free guide:
Download "3 Steps to Reduce Daily Anxiety" — short exercises you can try before our first session.
Get the guide

Contact form

Confidentiality & privacy: Communications by email or web form are not fully secure. By contacting me you consent to receive replies by the contact method you provide. Sessions are confidential within legal and ethical exceptions (e.g., imminent risk of harm, suspected abuse, or court order). For details, please request the privacy & informed consent document.
Crisis notice: If you are in crisis or are at risk of harming yourself or others, call 911 or your local emergency number, or contact your nearest crisis hotline. Therapy here is not an emergency service.
Scope & boundaries: Services are therapeutic and supportive; they are not a substitute for medical care. If you are receiving psychiatric medication, coordination with your prescriber may be recommended with your permission.

Ready to schedule?

If you prefer, call or email to arrange an intake. I aim to respond within 48 hours on business days.
Book an intake
